
---

**First time opening Roomtone?** The Mac download is signed and notarised by Apple and opens normally. On Windows, the easiest way is the [Microsoft Store](https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9MXNHZ6K9NJQ) (signed by Microsoft, updates itself). The installer attached here isn't signed, so SmartScreen warns once: **More info › Run anyway**. Step by step, with the permission questions and how to check your download: [Opening Roomtone for the first time](https://github.com/ChrispyGee/Roomtone/blob/main/docs/FIRST_RUN.md). Roomtone for Mac is built for Apple silicon only; every file's checksum is in `SHA256SUMS`.
